newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: High Singapore bunker offers deter buyers.
newsitem.headline: High Singapore bunker offers deter buyers.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes rose in line with stronger cargo prices but demand remained thin, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $101 and 180-cst at $108-$109 per tonne, about $3-4 per tonne higher than Thursday's quotes.
"We have to raise offers as cargo prices are strong but the high offers are not attracting any buyers," said one major.
"The market is very quiet," he said.
MDO and gas oil were priced at $190-$205 and $210-$220 per tonne respectively.
